premises.text: The venture builds products in underexplored greenfield technology areas to learn by shipping
premises.evidence_span: looking at areas of technology that we think haven't really been fully explored

premises.text: A digital gnome is a unique object that can live on only one device at a time
premises.evidence_span: a gnome can only live on one device. He's a digital object, but he's uniquely placed in one physical location all the time

premises.text: Users create custom gnomes and transfer them between devices via a magical lift process
premises.evidence_span: create a custom gnome, just like we created Lebowski

premises.text: Travel check-ins and photos notify everyone who has had the gnome along its path
premises.evidence_span: everybody who's been along that path with Disrupt will actually get to comment and join in the fun

premises.text: Lyft enables drag-and-drop interconnectivity of content across different devices
premises.evidence_span: a way of doing a different way of device interconnectivity

value.text: Carry, share, and follow a personal digital gnome across places and friends
value.evidence_span: wouldn't it be cool to have a gnome in your pocket?

secondary_value.evidence_span: how can I connect them in a more interesting way?

causal_links.evidence_span: take him with you, to build your very own custom gnome

notes: Singleton D2 retained: speaker explicitly hands off to a second product (Lyft) framed as a separately interesting interconnectivity module (§4.1(5)). Customization UI, map following, and lift demo folded into the gnome mechanism. Travel miles and lab anecdotes excluded as demo/traction. Greenfield exploration coded as an operating strategy condition, not pure vision.
